lede: Nebraska carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.3 against -1.4, a 2.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Nebraska -19.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Nebraska winning 90% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offensive line, where Nebraska leads Maryland by 93 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 89% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
